summary: Records keyboard key-down and key-up events into a FIFO table, with key, shortcut, panel, modifier, callback, and line-limit controls.

key_params.note: Distinguish left and right modifier keys

key_params.note: Operator used for callback relative paths

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Clamp output to max line count

key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

common_gotchas: The DAT is event-driven and FIFO; clamp or clear it in long-running systems to prevent unbounded tables.
Perform Mode capture and panel filters can make events appear missing if they do not match the current UI context.
Callback execution location affects relative operator lookups.
key_concepts: Logs keyboard events into a FIFO DAT table.
Active, Perform, Keys, Shortcuts, and Panels constrain which keyboard sources are captured.
Modifier handling can distinguish left/right modifier keys when enabled.
Received message callbacks and clamp/max-lines controls shape event handling and retention.
